endorsements.quote: Third, trust mechanisms for model exchange must be established, including versioning, provenance tracking, and validation benchmarks, so that institutions can assess the reliability and scope of externally derived model components before integration into local systems.

unlisted_practices: Develop interoperable protocols with standardized interfaces for exchanging model weights, embeddings, distilled representations, and performance metadata for model-centric collaboration.

Define clear rules for access control, responsibility allocation, and continuous auditing in decentralized model-exchange networks, using governance-by-design rather than relying on technical safeguards alone.
Establish explicit agreements on liability, auditability, and decision authority among institutions participating in decentralized model networks.
Design distillation protocols, validation strategies, and post-exchange performance monitoring to identify and mitigate blind spots from unobserved local knowledge.
Establish governance agreements for model exchange in advance, before institutions collaborate in a decentralized model network.
Implement validation, provenance tracking, and rollback mechanisms to prevent bias amplification and error propagation across decentralized model networks.
